task_criteria: The landed commit 4720cdc files row CF-075 on the published tree. git show 4720cdc:.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl parses and carries a row with id CF-075, status pending, priority P2 and a non-empty probe field; git show --name-status 4720cdc lists only .coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl and .coding-hermes/board/events.jsonl, with the event log gaining exactly one task_created entry whose task_id is CF-075, and no code or test file changed. The REPAIR is future work tracked by the pending row CF-075 and is explicitly NOT expected at this commit: this task grades the filing only, never the fix.
